rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when people or groups perform an action by turns.

example.english: We alternate keeping an eye on the stove.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 leon4 lau4 tai2 zyu6 go3 lou4 fo2

rows.note: Use this when events, states, or physical features replace one another in succession rather than when people simply take turns.

example.english: Day and night alternate, and the seasons cycle.
example.jyutping: zau3 je6 gaau1 tai3 sei3 gwai3 ceon4 waan4

rows.traditional: 一時 A 一時 B
rows.jyutping: jat1 si4 A jat1 si4 B
rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when describing two conditions or types of terrain that keep varying or alternating.

example.english: As I drive along this road, I alternate between flat and steep stretches, so I have to be careful.
example.traditional: 呢條路一時平一時斜，揸車要好小心。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 lou6 jat1 si4 ping4 jat1 si4 ce4 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1
